title: Major Demo Update for KRUEL
author: No_Background9234
selftext:
i updated my games DEMO today on itch with all the implemented fixes from my alpha build and added a tutorial system to help new players not get stuck and confused at what to do.

I would love to get feedback on it. 

I had claude help me design the LAB tool in game to where i can adjust my code manually while in game and to be able to make a tilemap system better than godot has to offer. 

the video is the LAB too using the "builder tab" in action

  
link: [https://anotherdayinparadise.itch.io/kruel](https://anotherdayinparadise.itch.io/kruel)

if anyone is interested
